extraction_notes: The electrical table publishes guaranteed hFE minimums and one maximum at IC = 10 mA; these bounds are preserved and are not converted into typical values.
The digitized curves are approximate readings of the T_J = 25 degC traces and use SI units for the axes.
The datasheet has no output-characteristics IC-versus-VCE family of curves, so VAF cannot be extracted from a figure for an F2 fit.
No tabulated VBE(on) row is published; VBE(on) is available from the digitized Fig. 19 typical curve at VCE = 1.0 V.
Cobo and Cibo are guaranteed maximum capacitances at single stated reverse-bias and frequency points, not typical values.
Absolute maximum ratings include VCEO = 40 V, VCBO = 60 V, VEBO = 6 V, continuous IC = 0.2 A, peak IC = 0.9 A, and board-dependent PD; only VCEO is represented by this schema.
omission_reason: VAF is omitted because the datasheet provides no output-characteristics curve for Early-voltage extraction; VBE(on) has no electrical-table row and is represented only by a digitized typical curve.
